essence: Successful practice of the mantra confers royal honor, splendor, and universal worship.
The mantra begins with the māyā, śrī, and kāma bījas followed by the word kṛṣṇāya.
Adding the fifth bīja to the earlier components yields a mantra with seven parts.
The mantra continues with the epithet gopījanavallabhāya and a triad of lotuses.
The completed twenty-three-syllable mantra yields both worldly enjoyment and liberation.
